§1.title: Introduction
§1.objective: Body signals as nested oscillations; why stationary Fourier/wavelet views lose AM; why this matters for brain aging; central thesis and three-signal scope

§2.title: The HHSA Framework
§2.objective: Layer-1 decomposition (EMD -> EEMD/CEEMDAN/masking) -> IF/IA via Hilbert -> layer-2 decomposition of envelopes -> H(t, f_c, f_AM); three projections S(t,f), C(f,w), M(t,w); physical admissibility f_AM < f_c; contrast with PAC and bispectrum

§3.title: Search Strategy
§3.objective: Databases, exact queries, dates, counts, inclusion criteria; PRISMA-ScR flow figure from prisma_flow.json
§3.note: Fully supported by all 130 verified records across shards S1-S5 reconciled in prisma_flow.json and references.bib

§4.1.title: Brain Oscillations
§4.1.objective: What HHSA/AM revealed in AD/MCI, PD, depression, SSVEP, tACS, and working memory; user's own study (U1 Chu et al. 2023) evaluated on equal footing

§4.2.title: Heart & Autonomic Rhythms
§4.2.objective: EMD/HHT in HRV; what an AM axis adds over LF/HF; autonomic aging; ultra-short-term (<10 min) wearable BBI validity as the practical ceiling

§4.3.title: Metabolic Signals & Glucose Dynamics
§4.3.objective: Glucose rhythms (circadian/ultradian/meal); CGM consensus metrics comparator; glycaemic variability and cognitive decline; sampling (5-min / 10-min Nyquist) and record-length limits

§4.4.title: Across Systems: Cross-Frequency Coupling & Network Physiology
§4.4.objective: Cross-system coupling, cardiorespiratory/gastric/glucose phase-amplitude coupling, sharp-wave ripple metabolic link (mostly hypothesis)

§5.title: Worked Demonstrations
§5.objective: Synthetic ground truth -> CGM (13 days) -> Garmin HRV sessions A/B; 3-D cube renders + 3 projections; what each can and cannot show

§6.title: Discussion: Pitfalls, Reporting Checklist, and Outlook
§6.objective: Sampling vs Nyquist; record length vs slowest band (13 days CGM; 7 min puts VLF out of reach); ensemble size; mode mixing; edge effects; envelope choice; admissibility; surrogate testing; reporting checklist Table 3; wearable multimodal HHSA

§7.title: Conclusion
§7.objective: 3-4 sentence core synthesis, no new claims; body signals as nested oscillations where AM recovers the missing physiological axis
